title: A Study to Evaluate Treating Watery Noses With Cryotherapy in the Clinic Setting. This is Cold Therapy, Freezing the Issues at the Back of the Nose to Ease Symptoms.
official: Cryotherapy to the Nose for Chronic Rhinitis: A Single Site, Pilot Study in Adults
summary: Adult patients presenting with rhinitis who have persistent rhinitis despite appropriate medical treatment will receive a session of cryotherapy for the nose.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria: Adult patients presenting to the ENT Department at Lister Hospital with Rhinitis may be included. Symptoms may include nasal congestion and/or rhinorrhea with/without nasal itching and sneezing.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Confirmed CRS
* Allergic Rhinitis
* Cryoglobulinemia
* paroxysmal cold hemoglobinuria
* cold urticarial Raynaud's disease
* open and/or infected wounds or other skin conditions at or near the target tissue
